title: Consume forwarding vectors in Rust and C
description: Final review follow-up from b7z9.144: test/vectors/forwarding_buffer.json is behaviorally exercised by Python but Rust only checks constants and C uses hard-coded scenarios. Add independent Rust/C vector consumers so shared forwarding semantics cannot drift.
